PRESIDENT'S ORDER 4 OF 1984
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
4 OF 1984
JUDGES OF THE
FEDERAL SHARIAT COURT (ASSIGNMENT OF FUNCTIONS) ORDER, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 7th October, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.---The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the Judges of the Federal
Shariat Court (Assignment of Functioni) Order, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---In this
Order, "Judge" means a Judge of the Federal Shariat Court, whether
appointed before or after the commencement of this Order, and includes the
Chief Justice of the said Court.
3. Order to override other
laws.-(1) The provisions of this Order shall have effect notwithstanding
anything contained in any other law for the time being in force.
4. Assignment of functions,
etc.-(1) The President may at any time, by order in writing,-
(a) modify the
term of appointment of a Judge ;
(b) assign to a
Judge any other office ; and
(c) require a
Judge to perform such other functions as the Prerident may deem fit;
and pass such
other order as be may consider appropriate.
(2) While he is performing the
functions which he is required under clause (1) to perform, or holding any
other office assigned to him under that clause, a Judge shall be entitled to
the same salary, allowances and privileges as are admissible to the Chief
Justice or, as the case may be, Judge of the Federal Shariat Court.
